newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds players sidelined by currency.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds players sidelined by currency.

text.p: volatile currencies kept most UK meals and feeds players on the sidelines on Wednesday, traders said.
"Most people don't know what to do for the best at the moment so they are keeping their heads down," said one trader.

A lower sterling against the dollar pushed high protein soymeal up by one to two stg a tonne despite the easier close in Chicago on Tuesday, adding to the cautiousness evident in the market. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
